item.title: web scraping locally
item.description: This is particularly useful when you’re using Selenium. Instead of having the code open the browser to access a link (very slow), having the code open a link from an existing browser is so much faster. But this, in my opinion, is just a side benefit of web scrapping locally. Where it really shines though is when you have a login page (e.g the online database for Indonesia’s M.C.G agency in my real-life scenario) and you do not want to go through the hassle of writing ten(s) lines of code just to do that (use this wisely)

item.title: 9aclass.net + Zoom card
item.description: Remember online classes? 9aclass.net was built on Google Site, to serve as a ‘phonebook’ with the meeting code, password, and link for each classroom listed. The search directory was built to be really simple. If one needed to look up, the meeting link for, say, math class, one simply needed to type: 9aclass.net/math But typically, students wouldn’t need to manually search the meeting details thanks to the Zoom card. But it is good to have the search function especially when the Zoom card fails to serve the right information (see later).
